text.arabic_uthmani: مَا قَدَرُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ حَقَّ قَدْرِهِۦٓ ۗ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَقَوِىٌّ عَزِيزٌ

words.gloss_range: negative particle opening the first clause and scoping over the completed failed-estimation frame
words.prose: {{ar:مَا}} ({{tr:mā}}) makes denial the entry point of the ayah. Its scope covers the whole first beat, not only the verb: the attempted estimation, the named object, and the due standard all stand under negation. Because the form selects negation here rather than an interrogative or relative function, the opening is a verdict on failed measure, and the later emphatic assertion answers that denial.

topics.headline: whole measuring relation negated
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the denial covers the entire failed measuring relation, not just a bare non-action.
topics.reason: The attachment evidence treats words 1-5 as one negated verbal clause, so the particle governs the full estimation frame.

topics.headline: negative value selected by syntax
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the particle is not opening a question or relative clause; it is syntactically fastening denial to a perfect verb.
topics.reason: QAC marks the particle as negating the following perfect verb, and the clause boundary supports that value.

topics.headline: opening denial answered by emphatic assertion
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the two-beat movement: denied human estimation is followed by confirmed divine attribute.
topics.reason: The first clause begins with negation, while the second clause uses an emphatic particle plus predicate emphasis.

words.gloss_range: they measured, estimated, or valued, here negated as a completed collective failure against God's due measure
words.root_gloss_range: root range of measuring, estimating, determining, apportioning, decree, capacity, and power; the local Form I verb selects estimation while the wider range adds capacity and determination pressure

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: the proper divine name as object of the failed estimation
the true and due standard of His measure

words.prose: {{ar:قَدَرُوا۟}} ({{tr:qadarū}}) casts the failure as a completed collective act: the plural ending supplies the group, while no explicit actor noun is repeated. The verb takes {{ar:ٱللَّهَ}} ({{tr:allāha}}) as object and then reaches the internal standard {{ar:حَقَّ قَدْرِهِۦٓ}} ({{tr:ḥaqqa qadrihī}}), so the failure is not vague underestimation but a failure against the right measure. The {{ar:ق د ر}} ({{tr:q-d-r}}) root also keeps measure, worth, determining, and capacity in view, while the local Form I frame keeps the act on the side of estimating rather than gaining power over God. The recurring formula appears in 6:91, 22:74, and 39:67; here it is answered by the final strength-and-inaccessibility seal rather than by 39:67's cosmic-grip imagery.

topics.headline: completed collective failure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah reports a judged collective failure, not an unresolved attempt by an unnamed individual.
topics.reason: The perfect active 3mp form carries subject agreement, and the boundary rows connect that collective to the prior parabolic address in 22:73.

topics.headline: object measured against internal standard
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the verb is judged by both its object and its internal standard: God is the attempted object, and His measure exposes the failure.
topics.reason: The local attachments identify an explicit object at word 3 and a cognate-accusative standard spanning words 4-5.

topics.headline: measure, decree, and capacity pressure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that estimation shades into worth, determination, and capacity, while the local verb still names failed estimating rather than human power over God.
topics.reason: The root family supports measure, decree, and capacity pressure, but the local Form I verb with object and internal standard selects estimation in this clause.

topics.headline: formula specialized here
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the formula shared by 6:91, 22:74, and 39:67, with this occurrence specializing the failure through the final attributes.
topics.reason: The CRITICAL rows give the formula references 6:91, 22:74, and 39:67; 22:74 continues into the attribute pair rather than the cosmic scale of 39:67.

topics.headline: parable evidence becomes verdict
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that 22:73's weakness demonstration becomes 22:74's explicit diagnosis of mismeasurement.
topics.reason: The boundary rows tie the fly parable and weakness verdict in 22:73 to the failed estimation named in 22:74.

words.gloss_range: the proper divine name as the direct object of failed estimation, not a generic deity term
words.root_gloss_range: divine-name field associated with deity, worship, devotion, and debated bewilderment or exaltation pressure; local form is the proper name
words.prose: The first {{ar:ٱللَّهَ}} ({{tr:allāha}}) stands in the object slot of the failed measuring verb. That grammar lets the ayah name the attempted object plainly, while the proper-name form prevents a generic deity comparison. The suffix in {{ar:قَدْرِهِۦٓ}} ({{tr:qadrihī}}) loops back to this name, so the measured object becomes the possessor of the standard that judges the measuring. The disputed divine-name field can add worship, devotion, bewilderment, or exaltation pressure, but the local form remains the proper name rather than an ordinary noun.

topics.headline: object becomes standard's antecedent
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the paradoxical loop: God is grammatically objectified, yet His own measure judges that objectification.
topics.reason: The local syntax makes word 3 the direct object, and word 5's possessive suffix refers back to the same referent.

topics.headline: proper name blocks generic deity comparison
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the failed estimate concerns the unique named God, not a member of a comparison class.
topics.reason: QAC identifies the word as a proper noun, and contextual evidence gives the dominant referent as God.

topics.headline: devotion and bewilderment pressure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the proper name carries devotional and bewildering pressure, while the local syntax does not turn it into a common noun.
topics.reason: The derivational dispute is semantically useful, but local evidence keeps the surface as the proper divine name in an object slot.

topics.headline: object role prepares assertion role
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the same name first enters as the object in the recurring formula and then returns as the asserted subject.
topics.reason: The formula recurs in 6:91, 22:74, and 39:67, and the same ayah repeats the name as the governed subject of the emphatic clause.

topics.headline: same-surah power seal prepared
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the familiar divine name in the surah is drawn into a power formula that also appears at 22:40.
topics.reason: The source rows connect the repeated divine name and final attribute formula with the same-surah use at 22:40.

words.gloss_range: the true, right, due standard inside the estimation construction, functioning adverbially rather than as another measured object
words.root_gloss_range: truth, rightness, reality, verification, realization, and due claim; local use selects the due-standard noun within the measuring phrase

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: the proper divine name as the measured object

words.prose: {{ar:حَقَّ}} ({{tr:ḥaqqa}}) is the hinge that turns repeated measure language into an evaluated standard. It does not become another object beside {{ar:ٱللَّهَ}} ({{tr:allāha}}); it specifies the true and due way the measuring would have had to meet {{ar:قَدْرِهِۦٓ}} ({{tr:qadrihī}}). The {{ar:ح ق ق}} ({{tr:ḥ-q-q}}) field keeps truth, right, reality, verification, and deserving in view, while the local construction narrows that pressure into the due standard of God's measure. The same due-action pattern appears later in 22:78, where right striving is named with a parallel construction.

topics.headline: internal standard, not second object
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the word judges how the measuring should have been done rather than adding another thing measured.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence treats words 4-5 as the cognate accusative intensifying and specifying the verb.

topics.headline: truth, right, and reality as due standard
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the failure is ethical and ontological as well as quantitative: it misses what is true, right, real, and due.
topics.reason: The root range supports truth, right, and reality pressure, while local grammar keeps it as the standard noun in the estimation phrase.

topics.headline: bridge between act and possessive measure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the word mediating between their measuring act and God's own measure, so the root echo becomes a judged standard.
topics.reason: The word stands between the verb and the possessive noun, and the CRITICAL rows connect this pattern with 6:91 and 39:67.

topics.headline: due estimation and due striving
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that due estimation in 22:74 belongs to a same-surah pattern that later names due striving in 22:78.
topics.reason: The source rows explicitly compare 22:74 with 22:78 and tie the phrase back to the weakness and misdirected seeking shown in 22:73.

words.gloss_range: His measure, worth, rank, or determining standard; possessed by God and used to judge the failed human estimation
words.root_gloss_range: measure, extent, worth, rank, apportioning, decree, determination, and capacity; local gerund selects the possessed standard rather than the dominant capability adjective
words.prose: {{ar:قَدْرِهِۦٓ}} ({{tr:qadrihī}}) closes the first beat by making the standard belong to the very One being measured. The construct and suffix make the measure specifically His, not a general scale, and the singular keeps the clause focused on one proper standard. The noun carries measure, worth, rank, decree, and determining authority, but the local gerund form selects the possessed standard rather than a capability adjective. Its same-root answer to {{ar:قَدَرُوا۟}} ({{tr:qadarū}}) makes the failure circular: they measure, but the valid measure is God's own.

topics.headline: God owns the standard
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the standard of estimation belongs to God Himself, so the attempted measuring is judged from inside the referent it targets.
topics.reason: The noun is genitive in construct with a 3ms possessive suffix referring back to the divine name.

topics.headline: specific singular measure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the measure is specific and singular: not one scale among many, but His own proper standard.
topics.reason: The iḍāfa and suffix supply definiteness, and the surface is singular.

topics.headline: worth, measure, decree, and rank
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the noun is not mere quantity; it also carries worth, rank, and determining authority, while the local construction keeps it as a possessed standard.
topics.reason: The gerund profile is smaller and standard-focused, so the broader capacity field survives as pressure without replacing the local noun function.

topics.headline: root echo closes the formula
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the same root closing the formula in 6:91, 22:74, and 39:67: the failed act is answered by God's own measure.
topics.reason: The CRITICAL rows identify the same formula in 6:91, 22:74, and 39:67, and the local construction repeats the root from word 2.

words.gloss_range: emphatic and explanatory particle opening the second clause and governing its subject-predicate structure
words.prose: {{ar:إِنَّ}} ({{tr:inna}}) pivots the ayah from denied human estimation into confirmed explanation. It governs the repeated divine name and covers the full predicate span, so both final attributes belong to one emphatic response. Because no connector separates the two beats, the second clause reads as explanation, not as a merely added statement: the failed measure is answered by the assertion that God is strong and inaccessible in might.

topics.headline: governed two-predicate assertion
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the particle governs a full emphatic clause, not just the following name.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence gives word 7 as the governed subject and words 9-10 as predicates under this clause.

topics.headline: explanation after negation
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the second beat explains why the first beat's measuring failed.
topics.reason: The particle follows the completed negated clause directly, and the final predicate pair supplies the explanatory answer.

topics.headline: weakness verdict becomes assertion
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices 22:73's weakness verdict being converted into an emphatic divine-attribute assertion in 22:74.
topics.reason: The boundary row connects the fly parable's weakness verdict in 22:73 with the emphatic attribute clause in 22:74.

words.gloss_range: the proper divine name repeated as the governed subject of the emphatic clause, not a second object
words.root_gloss_range: divine-name field of deity, worship, devotion, and debated bewilderment or exaltation pressure; local use repeats the proper name under emphatic governance
words.prose: The second {{ar:ٱللَّهَ}} ({{tr:allāha}}) repeats the same surface case but changes the role. Word 3 was the object of failed estimation; word 7 is the governed subject of the emphatic clause. Repeating the name instead of using a pronoun makes the correction explicit: the One whom they failed to measure is reintroduced as the subject who bears the final attributes. The devotional and bewildering pressure of the name survives, but the main force here is role reversal.

topics.headline: accusative by governance, not objecthood
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the repeated accusative surface no longer means objecthood; it marks the governed subject of the assertion.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence marks word 7 as the subject governed by the emphatic particle, not as a direct object.

topics.headline: explicit reidentification after suffix
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah repeats the divine name at the assertion beat instead of relying on a pronoun.
topics.reason: The explicit proper name follows the possessive suffix at word 5 and begins the governed assertion.

topics.headline: same divine-name field carried forward
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the devotional and bewildering name is not replaced by an abstract pronoun, while the local role is still grammatical subject of assertion.
topics.reason: The same proper name carries its semantic field into the second clause, but local grammar determines the subject role.

topics.headline: object-to-subject reversal
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the ayah's internal correction: the name moves from attempted object of measurement to authoritative subject of the attribute claim.
topics.reason: The repeated name binds the two clauses while changing syntactic function from object in the first clause to governed subject in the second.

topics.headline: surah name thread concentrated
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the familiar divine name gathered into the emphatic attribute seal as the answer to failed measurement.
topics.reason: The source rows treat the repetition as a two-beat role reversal and as a same-surah concentration of the divine-name thread.

words.gloss_range: emphatic predicate prefix fastening certainty to the first final attribute

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: the emphatic particle opening the second clause

words.prose: {{ar:لَ}} ({{tr:la}}) is a small form with a large placement effect. It attaches to {{ar:قَوِىٌّ}} ({{tr:qawiyyun}}), not to the subject, so the first predicate becomes the landing point of emphasis. Together with {{ar:إِنَّ}} ({{tr:inna}}), it stacks certainty onto the answer to failed estimation, making the assertion of strength sound and look fused to the predicate itself.

topics.headline: emphasis attached to predicate
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the emphasis lands on the strength predicate, not merely on the divine name.
topics.reason: QAC and attachment evidence place the particle as the emphatic prefix before the first predicate.

topics.headline: certainty fused into word shape
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that a single prefixed letter makes certainty part of the heard and written predicate surface.
topics.reason: The particle contributes modal emphasis rather than root meaning, and it is proclitically attached to the adjective.

topics.headline: stacked assertion after verdict
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the second clause moving into verdict register through a stack of emphatic particles.
topics.reason: The emphatic particle at word 6 and the predicate prefix at word 8 jointly reinforce the final assertion after the 22:73 parabolic address.

words.gloss_range: intrinsically strong and powerful as the first emphatically marked predicate answering failed measure
words.root_gloss_range: strength, force, capacity, ability, and a distant emptiness or destitution pole in other derivations; local adjective selects stable inherent strength

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: the second final predicate, inaccessible and prevailing in might

words.prose: {{ar:قَوِىٌّ}} ({{tr:qawiyyun}}) is the first predicate of the emphatic clause and the word that receives the prefixed emphasis. Its adjective form states stable inherent strength, not an event of making something strong. After the weakness verdict of 22:73 and the failed measuring of 22:74, this attribute names what was missed: force-capacity that cannot be reduced to created weakness. The wider {{ar:ق و ي}} ({{tr:q-w-y}}) field may include an emptiness pole elsewhere, but here that contrast only sharpens the selected meaning of plenary strength. Its pairing with {{ar:عَزِيزٌ}} ({{tr:ʿazīzun}}) reprises the same-surah power seal from 22:40, and the doubled yāʾ followed by the heavy final attribute gives the strength claim audible pressure before the close.

topics.headline: first nominative predicate in paired closure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the adjective as predicate under the emphatic clause and as the first half of a matched final pair.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence marks this word as the first predicate, and its nominative indefinite form matches the following adjective.

topics.headline: stable inherent strength
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the clause asserts inherent force-capacity, not a momentary act of strengthening another.
topics.reason: The local form is a qualitative adjective, not a causative verb or event form.

topics.headline: emptiness pole sharpens plenary strength
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices a contrastive root-family edge: emptiness elsewhere sharpens the local assertion of full strength without becoming the local sense.
topics.reason: The local adjective selects strength; the emptiness-related derivative remains only contrastive root-family pressure.

topics.headline: strength bears stacked emphasis
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the strength predicate carrying the clause's full assertion load through the emphatic particle, prefix, and indefinite quality.
topics.reason: The emphatic particle governs the clause, the predicate prefix attaches to this adjective, and the adjective remains nominative indefinite.

topics.headline: weakness answered by power seal
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the attribute answering 22:73's weakness scene and joining the same power pair already heard at 22:40.
topics.reason: The CRITICAL rows connect the weakness verdict in 22:73 and the same pair at 22:40 with this closing predicate.

topics.headline: audible pressure before final seal
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the doubled sound gives the strength claim audible weight before the final attribute lands.
topics.reason: The sound row has a modest but distinct payoff tied to the closing attribute cadence.

words.gloss_range: mighty, inviolable, inaccessible, and uniquely precious as the second final predicate sealing the assertion
words.root_gloss_range: might, strength, prevailing power, rarity, preciousness, inaccessibility, reinforcement, and inviolability; local adjective selects stable inaccessible might rather than causative making-mighty action

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: the first final predicate, intrinsically strong
the paired final attributes of strength and inaccessible might

words.prose: {{ar:عَزِيزٌ}} ({{tr:ʿazīzun}}) lands as the final word and completes the predicate pair. It matches {{ar:قَوِىٌّ}} ({{tr:qawiyyun}}) in form, so the close is a locked cluster rather than a loose list. Its root field adds inaccessible, prevailing, rare, and precious might: not more force alone, but force that cannot be reached, overcome, or replicated. The adjective form states an intrinsic quality rather than an act of making someone mighty, and the pair {{ar:قَوِىٌّ عَزِيزٌ}} ({{tr:qawiyyun ʿazīzun}}) recurs in 11:66, 22:40, 22:74, 42:19, 57:25, and 58:21 as a power formula suited to created limitation. The matching -un endings and doubled consonantal weight give the final pair a joined cadence that reinforces the closure.

topics.headline: second predicate locked to first
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the final adjective as a bound second predicate, not an unrelated extra description.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence licenses it as a second predicate coordinated in meaning with the first predicate.

topics.headline: might as inaccessible and non-replicable
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the closing attribute adds inaccessibility, rarity, and irreplaceability to strength.
topics.reason: The local adjective supports might and inaccessibility, while the CRITICAL rows preserve rarity and preciousness as reader-facing pressure.

topics.headline: intrinsic quality, not making-mighty action
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the word asserts stable inviolable might rather than an event of reinforcing or making another mighty.
topics.reason: The selected local form is a qualitative adjective, not a causative verbal form.

topics.headline: recurring force-plus-inviolability formula
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the pair in 11:66, 22:40, 22:74, 42:19, 57:25, and 58:21 as a formula joining force with inviolability.
topics.reason: The source rows give the recurring pair in 11:66, 22:40, 22:74, 42:19, 57:25, and 58:21 and explain it as force plus inaccessibility.

topics.headline: final inaccessible-might landing
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the ayah ending where failed measure is sealed by inaccessible might.
topics.reason: The word is the ayah's final word and completes the emphatic answer to the weakness scene in 22:73.

topics.headline: paired cadence reinforces closure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the final pair's cadence and phonetic weight joining the two attributes as one closure.
topics.reason: The sound rows give a distinct but modest payoff in the paired final cadence.

topics.headline: quality inside clause, not standalone title
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the word functioning as an indefinite predicate quality in the clause, even though the same root often appears as a standalone divine title elsewhere.
topics.reason: The local form is an indefinite adjective, and the same-surah reprise at 22:40 confirms the quality-pair function here.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The repeated ق د ر at words 2 and 5 is qualified by حَقَّ and answered by قَوِىٌّ عَزِيزٌ.
baseline_models.mechanism: The clause stages an attempted measurement, requires that measurement to match reality, then supplies gathered force and prevailing efficacy as the result that exceeds the attempted bound.

activation_trace.role: A quantity that brings a thing to its limit supplies the human scale and the upper bound that fails.
Reality-matching fixity makes truth, rather than human impression, the criterion of the estimate.
Strength gathered like the capacities of a rope supplies coherent force that the proposed scale cannot contain.
Prevailing over opposition turns capacity into an externally unopposed outcome.

changed_reading.before: They failed to esteem God highly enough.
changed_reading.after: They used a bounded scale whose result is falsified by coherent, prevailing power; the defect lies in the measuring frame, not only in the amount of praise.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: ٱللَّهَ is the direct object of قَدَرُوا۟, while حَقَّ makes the appraisal a due owed to its object.
baseline_models.mechanism: Worship, obligatory right, and effective sovereignty combine to make appraisal performative: recognition is shown by yielding the allegiance warranted by the one appraised.

activation_trace.role: The worshipped one makes the missed measure a failure of directed worship, not a detached numerical error.
A binding due turns correct appraisal into an obligation that can be withheld.
Effective capacity, possession, and command identify what the withheld due should acknowledge.
Might and inviolable standing make refusal of the due an inversion of actual rank.

changed_reading.before: The verse reports an inaccurate opinion about God.
changed_reading.after: The verse indicts a practical withholding of God's due rank and worship from the one whose effective sovereignty warrants them.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The cognate repetition قَدَرُوا۟ ... قَدْرِهِۦ makes the act of measuring answer to the measured one's own measure.
baseline_models.mechanism: Images of correspondence and a right-fitting joint recast the failure as instrument-object mismatch: even a large estimate is false if its categories do not fit what is being measured.

activation_trace.role: Coming in accordance with a proper measure supplies the calibration relation between estimate and object.
A right that fits its exact place like a joint or receptacle supplies the image of structural fit.
Integrated strength is the feature the ill-fitted instrument fails to register.

changed_reading.before: Their estimate is simply too small.
changed_reading.after: Their estimate is structurally miscalibrated: its categories do not fit the reality being assessed, regardless of how emphatically it is stated.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The closing pair قَوِىٌّ عَزِيزٌ follows the failed appraisal as its causal correction.
baseline_models.mechanism: The two predicates are not redundant: ق و ي supplies internally gathered capacity, while ع ز ز supplies the passage from capacity to prevailing, reinforced efficacy against resistance.

activation_trace.role: Gathered strands of force supply the internal capacity stage.
Overcoming opposition supplies the external efficacy stage.
Reinforcement makes the second predicate intensify and operationalize the first rather than merely repeat it.

changed_reading.before: Strong and mighty are two synonymous honorifics.
changed_reading.after: The pair gives a two-stage profile: force is coherently present and then proves irreducible by resistance.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediately preceding parable constructs a failed comparison class: aggregated claimants cannot perform even measured creation or recover a tiny loss, and both ends of their dependency are weak. The focus verdict therefore rejects the scale that lets such agents be compared with God at all.

activation_trace.role: The focus root supplies the scale whose comparison class is exposed as invalid.
Coherently gathered force answers the parable's aggregation of agencies that remains powerless.
Creation as prior measuring and shaping makes inability to create an inability to originate even a workable measure.
The gathering of separate capacities tests whether aggregation can become effective force; here it cannot.
Failure to extract a thing from another's hold supplies a concrete test of ineffective agency.
Weakness as the direct contrary of force sets the parable's agents against the focus predicate قَوِىٌّ.
Seeking and being sought form a reciprocal dependency in which neither side controls the desired outcome.

structural_cues: 22:73 immediately precedes the focus and ends with the explicit weakness of both seeker and sought.
The branchless theft cue in 22:73 makes loss and failed recovery the parable's material test.
The focus answers ضَعُفَ with قَوِىٌّ before closing with عَزِيزٌ.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies aggregation, failed creation, failed recovery, and reciprocal weakness; I infer that adjacency makes this a calibration test for قَدَرُوا۟; a live alternative is that the parable only condemns the invoked objects while the focus gives a general conclusion.

changed_reading.before: People underestimate God's degree of power.
changed_reading.after: People commit a comparison error: they place dependent, aggregatively weak agents on the same scale as the source of effective force.

context_deltas.mechanism: The exact closing pair has already appeared where force prevents the demolition of worship sites and vindicates expelled people. That recurrence gives the focus predicates an operational profile: strength is counterforce that preserves vulnerable worship rather than naked domination.

activation_trace.role: The focus predicate carries the gathered capacity whose earlier operation can specify it.
Prevailing efficacy completes the protective action against destructive opposition.
Turning away a harmful force supplies the earlier refrain's protective action.
The threatened collapse of built places supplies the concrete harm that force prevents.
Vindicating the wronged turns superior force toward restoration rather than self-display.
The earlier identical predicate attaches coherent capacity directly to the protective sequence.
The earlier identical predicate marks protection as able to prevail over the demolishing force.

structural_cues: 22:40 and 22:74 end with the exact sequence إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَقَوِىٌّ عَزِيزٌ.
In 22:40 the refrain follows expulsion, reciprocal defense, threatened demolition, and promised help.
The protected list spans multiple named kinds of worship site rather than a single private beneficiary.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an exact refrain attached first to defense and then to failed appraisal; I infer that repetition imports the earlier operational profile into the focus; a live alternative is that the phrase recurs only as a general assurance of capacity.

changed_reading.before: The closing attributes assert maximal force in the abstract.
changed_reading.after: The closing attributes recall force that checks destructive force, vindicates the wronged, and preserves spaces of worship; mismeasurement misses what power is for as well as how great it is.

context_deltas.mechanism: Human haste and explicit counting are set against a divine day compared with a thousand counted years. This activates ق د ر as temporal calibration: impatience mistakes a human clock for the measure of divine efficacy.

activation_trace.role: Quantity, limit, and term allow the failed measure to include duration.
Calculation and deliberate estimation supply the mistaken human timing model.
Hastening exposes the behavioral consequence of assuming the wrong time scale.
Counting supplies the explicit human operation by which the thousand-year comparison is framed.

structural_cues: 22:47 juxtaposes demands for haste with a direct one-day-to-one-thousand-years comparison.
The focus repeats the measurement root twice, allowing the earlier numerical comparison to remain latent.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies haste and an explicit mismatch between divine and human counting; I infer that this mismatch is one domain of the failed measure in 22:74; a live alternative is that 22:47 concerns patience and promise-keeping without specifying the later appraisal formula.

changed_reading.before: Failure to measure God concerns only magnitude of force.
changed_reading.after: Failure also concerns timing: delayed manifestation is misread as diminished power because the observer uses the wrong temporal scale.

context_deltas.mechanism: Life is stabilized through stages until an appointed limit, while the traversable world is directed and the sky is actively withheld from falling. Together these images make divine force a continuously calibrated restraint that holds processes in their viable measure.

activation_trace.role: Deliberate measuring, preparation, and ordering supply the calibration of unfolding processes.
Integrated force supplies the capacity to sustain many held relations at once.
Stabilization supplies the holding phase within staged generation.
An appointed temporal limit supplies the measured release point of the stabilized process.
Directing a thing toward a purpose supplies ordered usability rather than undirected force.
Holding and restraining make non-occurrence an active expression of power.
Falling and coming to rest name the event being continuously withheld.

structural_cues: 22:5 presents a long ordered sequence of formation, stabilization, term, emergence, maturation, decline, and revived earth.
22:65 makes the absence of catastrophe grammatically dependent on active holding and permission.
Both sequences combine motion with limits rather than depicting force as a single impact.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies staged stabilization, appointed limits, directed motion, and withheld falling; I infer that their common mechanism is calibrated sustaining force; a live alternative is that the two passages independently illustrate creation and mercy without defining قَوِىٌّ in the focus.

changed_reading.before: Strength is most visible when it breaks resistance.
changed_reading.after: Strength is also the exact restraint by which development reaches its term, motion remains useful, and catastrophic falling does not occur.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surah explicitly opposes God as fixed reality to what is invoked besides Him as lacking truth and stability, then describes worship without compelling warrant or disclosed knowledge. The focus failure is therefore not merely a low score but the category error of treating truth and nontruth as commensurable claimants.

activation_trace.role: The act of assigning a measure supplies the comparison operation under indictment.
Reality-matching truth supplies the criterion that blocks a shared scale with the unreal.
The explicit identification of God with stable reality establishes one side of the categorical contrast.
Departure from truth and stability establishes the invoked alternatives as a different category, not a smaller degree.
Submissive worship shows the practical allocation produced by the faulty comparison.
The absence of compelling proof removes an evidential basis for the alternative objects' claim.
The absence of disclosed knowledge makes the wrong worship an appraisal without cognitive uncovering.

structural_cues: 22:62 uses an explicit ٱلْحَقُّ versus ٱلْبَٰطِلُ antithesis.
22:71 repeats worship of what is besides God and negates both authority and knowledge before the fly parable.
The focus places حَقَّ inside the formula that judges the resulting measure.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies truth/nontruth antithesis and worship lacking proof or knowledge; I infer that 22:74 diagnoses the comparison itself as malformed; a live alternative is that حَقَّ in the focus denotes only an owed due while the ontological contrast remains background.

changed_reading.before: They rate God below rival powers.
changed_reading.after: They falsely construct a common scale for what is real and what lacks stable truth, then distribute worship according to that malformed comparison.

context_deltas.mechanism: A response measured by likeness is followed by vindication of the wronged and the capacity to leave punishment aside. This revises the force pair: true power can match harm without excess and can refrain without becoming weak.

activation_trace.role: Correspondence to a proper measure supplies calibrated proportionality.
Available force makes restraint a choice rather than incapacity.
Prevailing efficacy ensures that measured response is not imposed by an opponent.
Likeness and equivalence supply the upper bound on retaliatory response.
Vindication directs force toward the party wronged after the measured response.
Leaving punishment and erasing fault supplies power's capacity not to exhaust its available force.

structural_cues: 22:60 places retaliation by the like, promised help, and divine pardon in one compact sequence.
The sequence distinguishes measured redress from both passivity and unlimited retaliation.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies equivalence, vindication, and pardon; I infer that their adjacency gives a moral calibration to the later force predicates; a live alternative is that these clauses regulate human retaliation without specifying the semantic range of 22:74.

changed_reading.before: To measure God rightly is to imagine force without limit.
changed_reading.after: To measure God rightly includes seeing force that can prevail while remaining proportionate and can pardon without signaling weakness.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus sits immediately before divine selection of messengers, closed by hearing and seeing. Human appraisal fails; divine appraisal discriminates and chooses from both angels and people with full perceptual access.

activation_trace.role: Deliberative estimation supplies the evaluative operation that fails on the human side of the reversal.
Choosing a select part supplies the successful discriminating operation on the divine side.
Auditory apprehension supplies one axis of complete access surrounding the act of selection.
Visual apprehension supplies the complementary axis of access surrounding the act of selection.

structural_cues: 22:75 directly follows the focus with ٱللَّهُ يَصْطَفِى.
The movement is from plural human failure to singular divine choosing, then to paired perceptual predicates.
22:76 continues with comprehensive knowledge of what lies before and behind the selected agents.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies failed human appraisal followed immediately by selective divine appraisal and perceptual predicates; I infer an evaluative reversal across the verse boundary; a live alternative is that messenger selection begins a new topic without commenting on قَدَرُوا۟.

changed_reading.before: The verse only says that humans form too low an estimate.
changed_reading.after: The verse also marks an asymmetry of discernment: humans misappraise God, while God distinguishes and commissions agents with complete access to what He selects.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later exact pattern حَقَّ plus a possessed verbal noun turns due measure into due exertion, while worship, the removal of constriction, and holding fast prevent that exertion from becoming unbounded strain. Appraisal becomes embodied, proportionate allegiance.

activation_trace.role: A binding due supplies the relational obligation in the focus formula.
The object's proper measure supplies the proportion to which response must answer.
Submissive worship supplies the enacted form of recognizing the due.
The repeated due construction links proper appraisal to an obligation of response.
Exerting available capacity under difficulty supplies the response demanded by the echoed formula.
The explicit negation of constriction prevents due exertion from being read as crushing maximalism.
A protective holding fast supplies dependence on divine support within the demanded response.

structural_cues: 22:74 has حَقَّ قَدْرِهِۦ and 22:78 has حَقَّ جِهَادِهِۦ, the same حَقَّ plus possessed verbal-noun frame.
22:77-78 move through bowing, prostration, worship, good action, exertion, no constriction, and holding fast.
The closing commands convert the surah's evaluative language into bodily and communal practice.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an exact constructional echo plus embodied commands and a no-constriction clause; I infer that the later phrase answers failed appraisal with proportionate practice; a live alternative is that the two حَقَّ formulas are parallel intensifiers without a deliberate reciprocal relation.

changed_reading.before: Right measure is an inward judgment about divine greatness.
changed_reading.after: Right measure has an enacted correlate: worship and strenuous response proportioned to their object, yet bounded by the text's denial of constriction and its command to hold fast.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates a craft-like precision branch of ح ق ق rather than the ordinary truth or due senses; it remains anchored in focus حَقَّ and is independently triggered by removal followed by explicit tightening of the signs in 22:52; downstream prose should present it as a lexical-material analogy, not as a replacement translation.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: حَقَّ at word 4 can carry the image of tightly made speech, while the double ق د ر can carry deliberate estimation.

activation_trace.role: Tightly woven speech supplies a precision image latent in the focus criterion.
Deliberate measuring and preparation supply the calibration applied to discourse.
Removal followed by replacement supplies the first stage of textual repair.
Making something exact and secure supplies the second stage, in which the signs are tightened after disruption.

changed_reading.before: حَقَّ only states that the estimate should be true.
changed_reading.after: The focus can faintly evoke an estimate tested like tightly made discourse: disruption is removed, the wording is secured, and the resulting measure must withstand interference.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the syntax most naturally presents appraisal, not literal constriction; it remains anchored in the packet's constricting branch of ق د ر and is activated by the later explicit denial of constriction; downstream prose should say that the agents conceptually narrow God, not translate قَدَرُوا۟ directly as constricted.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The two occurrences of ق د ر at words 2 and 5 allow a narrowing branch to shadow the ordinary measure sense.

activation_trace.role: Reducing something to a narrow allowance supplies the image of compressing divine agency into a small conceptual frame.
The later denial of narrowness activates constriction as a live contrast rather than an isolated dictionary possibility.

changed_reading.before: They assign God too little greatness.
changed_reading.after: Their error may be pictured as projection: they compress divine agency into the narrow dimensions of their own religious and causal frame.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the difficult-to-obtain sense of عَزِيز beside the usual mighty sense; it remains anchored in the focus adjective and in the immediately preceding recovery and seeking mechanism; downstream prose should retain it as an anti-acquisition resonance, not claim that inaccessibility exhausts عَزِيز here.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: عَزِيزٌ at word 9 closes a parable organized around seeking, possession, theft, and failed retrieval.

activation_trace.role: Rarity and difficulty of attainment keep God from being treated as an object available on the parable's acquisition scale.
Failed extraction from another's possession exposes the invoked agents' inability to control even a recoverable object.
A sought object distant enough to require pursuit supplies the acquisition frame that the focus adjective exceeds.

changed_reading.before: عَزِيزٌ means only that God defeats opponents.
changed_reading.after: عَزِيزٌ also resists the worshippers' acquisition model: God is not one more sought possession whose availability can be tested like the stolen object in the parable.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising and form-distant because it activates the barren-land branch housed under ق و ي beside the adjectival قَوِىٌّ; it remains anchored in that supplied focus inventory and in the surah's concrete alternation between emptied habitation and green earth; downstream prose should mark it as a sound-root resonance about depletion and renewal, never as the direct lexical meaning of قَوِىٌّ.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: قَوِىٌّ at word 8 has a packet branch associated with empty, provision-poor land.

activation_trace.role: Barren emptiness supplies a negative-space resonance within the focus root's inventory.
Vacancy and emptiness make ruined habitation a concrete instance of depleted space.
Fresh green growth supplies the reversal from depleted space to living abundance.

changed_reading.before: Divine strength is inferred only from visible abundance or impact.
changed_reading.after: A distant root resonance lets strength span both emptied habitation and renewed greenness, so current depletion cannot serve as a measure of absent power.

strongest_changes: The fly parable changes underestimation into a failure of comparison: aggregated dependent agents never enter the same scale as effective force.
The exact refrain from 22:40 changes قَوِىٌّ عَزِيزٌ from abstract might into protective counterforce that preserves vulnerable worship.
Staged generation and the held sky change strength from impact alone into calibrated sustaining restraint.
The truth-versus-falsehood antithesis changes a low rating into an ontological category error with practical consequences for worship.
The echo حَقَّ قَدْرِهِۦ / حَقَّ جِهَادِهِۦ changes right measure from inward judgment into proportionate embodied response without erasing the no-constriction limit.
summary.what_was_special: The repeated measurement root did not settle into one meaning: scale, due, fit, planning, constriction, temporal calibration, and practical response remained coexisting. The closing force pair likewise stayed plural as prevailing power, protective counterforce, sustaining restraint, and proportionate capacity to pardon.
remaining_uncertainties: حَقَّ can foreground reality, binding due, structural fit, or crafted exactness; the focus grammar supports coexistence but does not force one branch.
The exact 22:40 refrain strongly activates a protective profile, though recurrence alone cannot prove that every detail of its earlier scene transfers to 22:74.
The constructional echo in 22:78 may be a deliberate reciprocal answer or only a shared intensifying formula.
The constriction, anti-acquisition, textual-tightening, and empty-land readings are live branch activations but require explicit downstream qualification because of form or domain distance.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Misvaluation follows the failed agency test.** Repeated `ق د ر B001/B005` supplies measure and deliberative estimation; `ح ق ق B001/B002` firm truth and due claim. After 22:73 compares creative and rescue capacities, I infer that worshippers assign God an estimate that does not reach the demonstrated extent of power. The verse reads as a measurement failure with practical consequences, not merely insufficient praise.
2. **Strength is cohesive and unovercome.** `ق و ي B001` images assembled rope-like strength; `ع ز ز B001/B004` might and reinforcement. In contrast to gathered idols that remain weak, I infer that divine power is internally coherent and itself reinforces others. The names answer the parable's failed collective by distinguishing true cohesion from mere aggregation.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 22:75 corrected the failed estimate by contrasting gathered weak claimants with divinely selected messengers whose fitness is known through complete hearing and sight.

reader_a.activated_readings_md: 1. **Idolatry is exposed as a calibration failure.** Fixed repeated `ق د ر:B001` supplies measuring a thing to its extent and `B003` effective capacity; `حَقّ` activates `ح ق ق:B003` (a particular due claim) and `B001` (firm reality). `22:73` had operationalized capacity through creation and rescue, then displayed universal weakness in the alternative relation. The correction supplies `ق و ي:B001` (assembled strength like rope strands) and `ع ز ز:B001` (might and honor) with `B002` (overcoming). The packet gives failed test and corrected attributes; I infer that the error is not lack of an honorific but use of a radically inadequate scale. “They did not measure” reads epistemically and causally.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: Later `22:75` unexpectedly shows strength through selective commissioning rather than spectacular force. This makes correct measure include the ability to entrust and oversee real agents.

baseline.text: Allah'a gerektiği gibi değer vermediler. Allah güçlüdür, üstündür.

findings.text: Allah'ı gereği gibi değerlendirememek, önceki güç deneyinin açığa çıkardığı bir ölçme ve değer biçme hatasıdır.
İlahî güç, dağınık kuvvet değil, karşı konulamayan ve parçalanmayan birleşik bir kudrettir.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: It exactly repeats the declaration that God is Strong and Mighty, grounding it in His decreed victory for His messengers.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: The human movement from weakness to strength and back makes created power visibly contingent, unlike the focus's divine strength.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_channel: P4 (22:58-78) - Counterfeit Custody Fails Under Minimal Resistance
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Claimed powers cannot authorize worship, control hostile response, create weak life, or recover what that life removes.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: The critique moves from missing warrant to failed custody: the supposed powers cannot protect meaning from anger or even protect an object from a fly.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: A Fly Defeats Claimed Possession
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Gathered objects of invocation cannot create a fly; when the fly strips something away, they cannot recover it, revealing weakness in seeker and sought.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi Tanrı'nın varlıkları belirli ölçü, son, vakit ve biçimlere göre bilgece hükme bağlamasını anlatır. Dal çerçevesi hem hüküm verme eylemini hem de onun düzenli ölçülerini korur.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Bu anlam sıradan nicelik hesabından ve yaratılmış bir öznenin bir işi yapabilme gücünden ayrıdır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanrısal hükmü bildiren temel biçim ile topluluk adı ve belirli geceyi anlatan söz öbeği ayrı tutulur; söz öbeğinin özel anlamı yalın biçime yayılmaz.

concept_map.definition: Tanrı'nın varlıkları bilgelik gereğince belirli ölçülere, sonlara, vakitlere ve özel biçimlere göre hükme bağlamasıdır.

facets.statement: Varlıklar hakkında Tanrısal bir hüküm ve belirleme bildirir.
Bu hüküm her şeyi belirli bir ölçüye, sona, vakte ve biçime yerleştirir.
Belirlemenin bilgelik gereğince ve özel amaçlara yönelik olması ilişkiyi sınırlar.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar, Tanrısal hükmün şeyleri gelişigüzel değil; belirlenmiş ölçü, son, vakit ve biçimlere göre, bilgelikle düzenlediği konusunda birleşir.

concept_gloss.text: Tanrı'nın varlıkları ölçülü biçimde hükme bağlaması

error_profile.loses: Ölçü, son, vakit, özel biçim ve bilgelik ayrıntılarını açıkça söylemez.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesinin çekirdeği, bir öznenin bir şeyi yapmasını mümkün kılan yerleşik güç ve egemenliktir. Tanrısal güç, insanın edindiği güç ve varlıklılık kullanımı bu çekirdeğin açıkça belirtilen görünümleridir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Bu dal ölçünün kendisi, önceden verilmiş hüküm, geçimi kısma veya yalnızca bir işin sonucunu yürürlüğe koyma değildir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Yapabilme gücünü bildiren biçimler ile varlıklılığı anlatan söz öbeği ayrı facetlerde tutulur; varlıklılık bütün dala yayılmaz.

concept_map.definition: Bir öznenin bir şeye sahip olmasını veya bir işi yapabilmesini sağlayan güç, yetkinlik ve egemenlik durumudur. Belirli bir söz öbeğinde geniş olanak ve varlıklılık anlamına uzanır.

facets.statement: Öznenin bir işi gerçekleştirmesini mümkün kılan yerleşik gücü ve yetkinliği bildirir.
Gücün sahip olma, egemen olma ve dilediğini gerçekleştirebilme görünümünü kapsar.
Belirli kişi nitelemesinde güç, geniş maddi olanak ve varlıklılık anlamına uzanır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Ortak kaynak çizgisi, özneyi eyleme elverişli kılan güç ve sahipliktir; bu güç Tanrı için sınırsız gerçekleştirme, insan için edinilmiş yetkinlik, belirli bir nitelemede ise varlıklılık olarak görünür.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi belirli yapılarda bir kişinin geçim payını kısmayı veya ona ayrılan şeyi daraltmayı açıkça bildirir. Dal çerçevesi bu daraltıcı eylemi doğru biçimde korur.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Anlam yalnızca belgelenmiş söz dizimlerinde geçerlidir; yalın köke genel bir daraltma veya yoksulluk anlamı yüklenmez.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım geçim payının kişi üzerinde kısılmasını bildiren söz öbekleriyle sınırlıdır ve yalın bir kök anlamı olarak genellenmez.

concept_map.definition: Belirli söz öbeklerinde, bir kişiyi veya ona ayrılan şeyi daraltmak; özellikle geçim payını azaltarak onun geçimini daraltmaktır.

facets.statement: Bir kişiyi ya da ona ayrılan şeyi daraltma eylemini bildirir; geçim payını kısma bunun başlıca örneğidir.
Daraltmanın hedefi, söz öbeğinde belirtilen kişi veya onun geçimidir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynakların ortak anlamı, söz öbeğine göre bir kişiyi veya ona ayrılan şeyi daraltmaktır; geçim payını kısmak ve kişiyi dar geçim durumuna sokmak bu çizginin belirgin örneğidir.

concept_gloss.applicability: Belirli söz öbeklerinde hem daraltma eylemini hem de bunun geçime ve kişiye yönelişini koruyan karşılıktır.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Etkilenen kişinin geçim koşullarının daraltıldığı bağlamlarda doğal bir eylem karşılığıdır.

branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه قدر عليه رزقه بمعنى ضيق أو قتر، ونقدر عليه بمعنى نضيق عليه، وكل جعل للشيء في قدر يسير بخلاف البسط.
branches.what_is_not_ar: ليس المراد هنا أصل القدرة، ولا مطلق التقدير المحمود، ولا القدر بمعنى القضاء إلا من جهة الاشتقاق.
branches.source_phrase_ar: من قدر عليه رزقه فمعناه قتر (maqayis)؛ قدر على عياله مثل قتر؛ قدر على الإنسان رزقه مثل قتر (sihah)؛ نضيق عليه؛ ضيق عليه (tahdhib)؛ قدرت عليه الشيء ضيقته؛ ومن قدر عليه رزقه أي ضيق عليه (mufradat)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi düşünme, ölçme ve karşılaştırma yoluyla bir işi tasarlama; ardından onu hazırlama, düzgünleştirme veya sağlam kurma çizgisini destekler. Ay sayısını tamamlama ve örgülü işi sağlamlaştırma bu çekirdeğin özel uygulamalarıdır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Bu dal düşünme ve hazırlama sürecidir; salt ölçü, Tanrısal hüküm veya eylemden önce var olan yapabilme gücü değildir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Genel tasarlama ve hazırlama kullanımları, ay hesabı ve örgülü işi sağlamlaştıran söz öbeklerinden ayrılır; özel uygulamalar yalın anlama yayılmaz.

concept_map.definition: Bir işi düşünerek, ölçüp karşılaştırarak tasarlamak ve onu istenen düzene göre hazırlayıp sağlamlaştırmaktır; bazı kullanımda bir şeyin kişi için hazır duruma gelmesini de bildirir. Ayın gün sayısını hesaplama ve örgülü bir işi düzgün kurma bunun özel uygulamalarıdır.

facets.statement: Bir işi düşünme, ölçme ve karşılaştırma yoluyla tasarlamayı bildirir.
Tasarlanan şeyi hazırlama, düzene koyma ve sağlamlaştırma sonucuna yönelir; sınırlı kullanımda bir şeyin kişi için hazır hale gelmesini de bildirir.
Belirli bir söz öbeğinde ayın gün sayısını hesaplamayı veya otuza tamamlamayı bildirir.
Belirli bir yapım bağlamında örgülü işi düzgün ve sağlam kurmayı bildirir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar, düşünme ve ölçüp karşılaştırmayla başlayan tasarlama sürecini hazırlama ve sağlam kurma sonucuna bağlar; ay hesabı ile örgülü yapının sağlamlaştırılması özel uygulamalardır, ayrıca bir şeyin kişi için hazır duruma gelmesi sınırlı bir kullanım olarak verilir.

concept_gloss.applicability: Dalın düşünme, ölçme, tasarlama ve hazırlanmış bir düzene ulaştırma aşamalarını birlikte veren karşılıktır.

error_profile.preserves: Düşünme, ölçme, tasarlama, hazırlama ve sağlam kurma çizgisini korur.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi ölçüsüne uygun gelme ve orta olma çevresinde toplanan, fakat kısa boyun, atın ayak basışı ve kolay yol alınan gece gibi kalıplaşmış nitelemeleri de içeren bir dizi söz öbeği verir. Dal kullanılabilir, ancak bunların tek bir yalın anlam değil, ayrı yapıya bağlı kullanımlar olduğu açıkça belirtilmelidir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Uygunluk ve orta olma ortak merkezdir; bedensel yapı, at yürüyüşü ve gece niteliği yalnızca belgelenmiş söz öbeklerinde geçerlidir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Bütün kullanımlar söz öbeğine bağlıdır; uygunluk, orta boy, kısa boyun, belirli at basışı ve kolay yolculuk anlamları yalın köke genellenmez.

concept_map.definition: Belirli söz öbeklerinde bir şeyin kendi ölçüsüne uygun gelmesini veya küçük ile büyük arasında orta nitelikte olmasını bildirir. Başka kalıplarda kısa boyunlu insanı, arka ayaklarını ön ayak izlerine basan veya bir kaynak varyantında bu izleri aşan atı ve yol alması kolay geceyi niteler.

facets.statement: Bir şeyin başka bir şeyin ölçüsüne uygun gelmesini bildirir.
Eyer, yük takımı veya boy gibi alanlarda küçük ile büyük arasında orta olmayı bildirir.
Belirli insan nitelemesinde kısa boylu veya kısa boyunlu olmayı bildirir.
Belirli at nitelemesinde arka ayakların ön ayakların bastığı yerlere basmasını veya bir kaynak varyantında bu izleri aşmasını bildirir.
Belirli gece nitelemesinde yolculuğun yumuşak ve kolay ilerlemesini bildirir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynakların toplu anlatımı, ölçüye uygunluk ve orta olma çevresindeki söz öbeklerini; insan yapısı, atın ayak basışı ve yolculuğun kolaylığına ilişkin kalıplaşmış nitelemelerle birlikte verir. At nitelemesinde kaynaklar arka ayağın ön ayak izine basması ile bu izi aşması arasında ayrılır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım, yalın eylem çekirdeğini türemiş eylem ve varlık adlarından ayırır; türemiş biçimlerin kapsamı yalın eylemin tamamına aktarılmaz.

concept_map.definition: Bir varlığa tapınma eylemini ve kişinin kendini tapınmaya vermesini anlatır. Türemiş kullanımlarda bir varlığı tapınılır kılmayı, tapınılan varlığı ve tapınma konusu sayılan varlıkları da adlandırır.

facets.statement: Temel eylem, bir varlığa tapınmak ve kişinin kendini bu tapınmaya vermesidir.
Eylemden türeyen varlık anlamı, kendisine tapınılan varlığı veya tapınma konusu sayılan nesneyi gösterir.
Ettirgen kullanım, bir varlığı başkalarınca tapınılır duruma getirme veya öyle sunma işlemini bildirir.
Güneşe kimi topluluklarca tapınılması nedeniyle ona tapınılan varlık anlamındaki bir ad verilmesi, varlık anlamının tarihsel bir örneğidir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynakların ortak çizgisi, tapınmayı anlamın temeli sayar; kişinin tapınmaya yönelmesini, tapınılan varlığı ve tapınılır kılma işlemini bu temelden türetir. Tapınma konusu sayılan yontular ve güneş örneği, varlık anlamının belirli uygulamalarıdır.

branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه أله وتأله بمعنى عبد وتنسك، والتأليه بمعنى التعبيد، والإله والآلهة والإلاهة لما جعل معبودا.
branches.what_is_not_ar: لا يدخل فيه أله بمعنى تحير، ولا ألهت على فلان بمعنى اشتد جزعي عليه، ولا أسماء المواضع أو الحية أو الهلال إلا من جهة التسمية لا معنى العبادة.
branches.source_phrase_ar: أصل واحد وهو التعبد، فالإله الله تعالى لأنه معبود، وتأله الرجل إذا تعبد، والإلاهة الشمس سميت بذلك لأن قوما كانوا يعبدونها (maqayis)؛ التأله التعبد (ayn)؛ أله بالفتح إلاهة أي عبد عبادة، مألوه أي معبود، الآلهة الأصنام، التأليه التعبيد، التأله التنسك والتعبد (sihah)؛ لا يكون إلاها حتى يكون معبودا، معبوداتهم من الأصنام والأوثان آلهة، الإلاهة الشمس، وإلاهتك وعبادتك (tahdhib)؛ إله اسما لكل معبود، أله فلان يأله الآلهة عبد، فالإله على هذا هو المعبود (mufradat)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi Yaratıcıya özgü adın kendisini, genel tapınılan-varlık adından türetiliş açıklamasını ve bu özel adla kurulan seslenme ile ant biçimlerini birlikte verir. Geçici çerçeve kullanılabilir, ancak dal yalnızca seslenme ve ant kalıpları değildir; özel adın yalın kullanımı da çekirdekte tutulmalıdır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal, özel ad ile bu ada bağlı seslenme, dilek, şaşma ve ant biçimleriyle sınırlıdır; herhangi bir tapınılan varlığı gösteren genel ad anlamına genişletilmez.

lexicalization_scope.note: Yalın özel ad, doğrudan seslenme biçimleri ve ant ya da şaşma kalıpları ayrı tutulur; kalıplara özgü işlevler özel adın her kullanımına genellenmez.

concept_map.definition: Yaratıcıya özgü adın kendisini ve bu adla kurulan seslenme, dilek, şaşma ve ant biçimlerini kapsar. Bu biçimler doğrudan seslenme, adın ant değeriyle kullanılması veya ses ve parçaların düşürülmesiyle kısaltılma yollarını gösterir.

facets.statement: Dalın merkezinde, Yaratıcıyı başkalarından ayırarak gösteren ve yalnız ona özgü sayılan özel ad bulunur.
Özel adın, tapınılan varlığı bildiren genel addan ses düşmesi ve belirleyici unsur eklenmesiyle oluştuğu açıklanır.
Özel ad, sözün başında ant değeri taşıyarak ardından gelen yapmama bildirimini güçlendirebilir.
Özel adın doğrudan ya da seslenme öğesi yerine geçen bir sonla kullanılması, yakarma ve dilek bildiren seslenme biçimleri kurar.
Ses veya parçaların düşürüldüğü kısalmış biçimler, şaşma ve ant anlatan kalıplarda kullanılır.

concept_map.definition: Bir düşüncenin, sözün ya da durumun gerçekten var olana uygun düşmesi ve bu nedenle yanlışın karşısında doğru, sağlam ve kesin sayılmasıdır. Söz bakımından ayrıca eğretilemenin karşısındaki gerçek anlamı kapsar.

facets.statement: Gerçekte var olana uygun düşen şey doğru ve sağlamdır.

neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal da bir savın doğru ve geçerli sayılmasını sağlayan işlemleri anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal doğruluğu belirleme ve onaylama sürecine, komşu dal ise kanıt veya yargı yoluyla sabitlemeye daha belirgin biçimde yönelir.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dal doğruluğu araştıran, onaylayan veya gösteren etkin bir işlemdir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal bir şeyin zaten gerçekliğe uygun ve doğru olma durumudur.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal da doğruluk ve gerçekliğe uygunluk çevresinde buluşur.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu dal doğruluğun belirlenmesi veya gösterilmesini, komşu dal ise işlemin sonucundan bağımsız olarak doğru olma niteliğini anlatır.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün komşu kartları değerlendirildi; kanıtla sabitleme ile yakınlık ve doğrulama işlemiyle doğru olma durumu arasındaki ayrım yayımlandı.
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه أحققت وحققت بمعنى أثبت الحق أو حكمت بكونه حقا أو صدقت القول، وإحقاق الحق بإظهار الأدلة أو إكمال الأمر.
branches.what_is_not_ar: لا يدخل فيه مجرد كون الشيء حقا دون فعل إثبات، ولا المخاصمة إلا إذا غلب وأثبت الحق.
branches.source_phrase_ar: حققت الأمر وأحققته أي كنت على يقين منه (maqayis)؛ حققت قوله وظنه تحقيقا أي صدقت (sihah)؛ حقق الرجل إذا قال هذا الشيء هو الحق (tahdhib)؛ أحققت كذا أي أثبته حقا أو حكمت بكونه حقا، ليحق الحق (mufradat)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi bu sözü Son Gün için özel bir ad olarak verir ve adlandırmayı bütün işlerin gerçekleşmesi, herkesin yaptığıyla yüzleşmesi ya da karşılığın kesinleşmesiyle açıklar. Dal çerçevesi bu özel göndermeyi doğru korur.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Bu dal genel bitiş veya zorunluluk değil, yapılanların karşılığının kesinleştiği Son Gün için kullanılan özel bir addır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Dal tek başına kullanılan özel bir olay adını tanımlar; başka söz öbeklerindeki bitiş, doğruluk veya zorunluluk anlamları buraya taşınmaz.

concept_map.definition: Bütün işlerin gerçek sonucuna ulaştığı, her insanın yaptıklarıyla yüzleştiği ve karşılığın kesinleştiği Son Gün için kullanılan addır.

facets.statement: Ad, insanların yaptıklarıyla yüzleştiği Son Gün olayını gösterir.
Adlandırma, o günde işlerin gerçek sonucuna ulaşması ve karşılığın kesinleşmesiyle açıklanır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Toplu tanıklık adı Son Günle özdeşleştirir; gerekçe olarak işlerin gerçekleşmesi, kişinin yaptığıyla yüzleşmesi ve karşılığın kesinleşmesi biçiminde birbirini tamamlayan açıklamalar sunar.

concept_gloss.applicability: Bütün insanların yaptıklarıyla yüzleşeceği ve karşılıkların kesin biçimde verileceği son yargı gününü adlandırır.

error_profile.preserves: Özel gün göndergesini, yüzleşmeyi ve karşılığın kesinleşmesini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Dini veya öğretici bir metinde herkesin yaptıkları için yargılanacağı son günü belirtirken kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Özel gün göndergesini ve insanların yaptıklarıyla yüzleşmesini korur.
error_profile.loses: Adın işlerin gerçekleşmesi ve karşılığın kesinleşmesi gerekçesini açıkça vermez.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: bütün karşılıkların kesinleştiği Son Yargı Günü

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dal belirli bir son yargı olayının özel adıdır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal genel olarak doğru, gerçek ve gerçekliğe uygun olma niteliğidir.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Adın açıklanmasında işlerin gerçek sonucuna ulaşması ve kesinleşmesi bulunur.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal tek bir gelecekteki olayı gösterir; komşu dal ise olay türünden bağımsız genel bir doğruluk ve gerçeklik niteliğidir.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dal insanların yaptıklarıyla yüzleşeceği özel Son Günü gösterir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal herhangi bir işin tamamlanmasını, sona ermesini veya tükenmesini anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.gloss: Son Gün ile genel sona erme
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her ikisi de bir sürecin artık sonuçlandığı bir son aşama tasarımında buluşur.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Komşu dal genel bir bitiş sürecidir; odak dal ise bitiş anlamından ibaret olmayan, yargı ve karşılık içeren özel bir gündür.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün komşular gözden geçirildi; özel olay adıyla genel doğruluk arasındaki iç ayrım ve sıradan sona ermeyle tematik yakınlık yayımlandı.
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه الحاقة اسما للقيامة أو الساعة لأنها تحق الأمور أو تحق كل إنسان بعمله أو يحق فيها الجزاء.
branches.what_is_not_ar: لا يدخل فيه كل قيام للحق أو كل وجوب؛ هو اسم مخصوص للقيامة في الشواهد.
branches.source_phrase_ar: الحاقة القيامة لأنها تحق بكل شيء (maqayis)؛ الحاقة القيامة سميت بذلك لأن فيها حواق الأمور (sihah)؛ سميت حاقة لأنها تحق كل إنسان بعمله (tahdhib)؛ الحاقة إشارة إلى القيامة لأنه يحق فيه الجزاء (mufradat)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesindeki söz burada soyut gerçeklik anlamına gelmez; kişinin koruması gereken şeyleri, ayrıca bayrak, dokunulmaz değer ve çevre gibi somutlaşmış kullanımları gösterir. Bu nedenle dalın tanımı gerçeklikten korunması gereken sorumluluk alanına çevrilmelidir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Çekirdek, kişinin korumakla yükümlü olduğu şeydir; doğru olma veya sözün gerçek anlamı bu dala girmez.

lexicalization_scope.note: Koruma yükümlülüğü yalın ad ve koruyucu kişi kalıbında görülür; bayrak, dokunulmaz değer ve çevre gibi kullanımlar ayrı alt görünümler olarak korunur.

concept_map.definition: Bir kişinin koruması, savunması ve çiğnetmemesi gereken şeylerin bütünüdür. Bayrak, dokunulmaz sayılan değer veya korunacak çevre bu sorumluluk alanını somutlaştırabilir.

facets.statement: Kişiye düşen görev, kendisine bağlı olan şeyi korumak ve savunmaktır.
Bayrak, dokunulmaz değer ve korunacak çevre, bu koruma yükümlülüğünün adla gösterilen somut karşılıklarıdır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Toplu tanıklık, kişinin koruması gereken şeyi temel alır; bayrak, dokunulmaz sayılan değer ve çevreyi bu koruma sorumluluğunun farklı somut karşılıkları olarak sıralar.

concept_gloss.applicability: Bir kişinin kendisine bağlı olduğu için korumak, savunmak ve çiğnetmemekle yükümlü bulunduğu şeyi anlatır.

error_profile.preserves: Korunacak nesneyi, kişiye düşen görevi ve savunma ilişkisini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Kişinin onur, yakın çevre veya dokunulmaz saydığı bir şeyi savunması gereken bağlamlarda uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Kişiye bağlı koruma ve savunma yükümlülüğünü korur.
error_profile.loses: Bayrak ve çevre gibi bütün somut karşılıkları tek tek kapsamaz.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Sözün doğrudan bir topluluğun korunup savunulan bayrağını gösterdiği bağlamda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Koruma sorumluluğunun bayrakla somutlaşan yönünü korur.
error_profile.loses: Dokunulmaz değer ve çevre gibi öteki somutlaşmaları kapsamaz.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: korunacak bayrak, dokunulmaz değer veya çevre

neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal dokunulmazlık, güvence, saygınlık ve çiğnenmemesi gereken bağları daha geniş biçimde kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal da çiğnenmemesi ve gözetilmesi gereken değer veya bağı anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal koruyucu kişiyle korunacak şey arasındaki görev ilişkisini öne çıkarır; komşu dal ise şeyin dokunulmaz niteliğine daha geniş yer verir.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dal korunması gereken şeyin kendisini ve ona bağlı görevi anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal bir kişiye yardım etme, onu yüceltme, sayma ve savunma eylemini anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dalda da birini veya bir şeyi koruma ve savunma davranışı yer alabilir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Burada çekirdek koruma yükümlülüğünün konusu olan şeydir; komşu dalda çekirdek kişiye yönelen destek ve savunma eylemidir.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar değerlendirildi; dokunulmazlıkla yakın sınır ve korunacak şeyle kişiyi savunma eylemi arasındaki ayrım yayımlandı.
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه حقيقة الرجل وما يحق عليه أن يحميه أو يلزمه الدفاع عنه، ومعه الراية والحرمة والفناء حيث نصت المصادر.
branches.what_is_not_ar: لا يدخل فيه الحقيقة ضد المجاز إلا إذا كان السياق على الثبات أو الوجود لا الحماية.
branches.source_phrase_ar: حامي الحقيقة إذا حمى ما يحق عليه أن يحميه ويقال الحقيقة الراية (maqayis)؛ الحقيقة ما يحق على الرجل أن يحميه (sihah)؛ الحقيقة الراية والحرمة والفناء وما يلزمه الدفاع عنه (tahdhib)؛ فلان يحمي حقيقته أي ما يحق عليه أن يحمى (mufradat)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi yalnız dişi deveyi değil, üç yaşını tamamlayıp dördüncü yaşına giren ve yük taşımaya elverişli hale gelen erkek ile dişi deveyi birlikte kapsar; ayrıca dişinin çiftleşme zamanını bildirir. Dal çerçevesindeki semirme bilgisi bu branch claim tarafından desteklenmez ve ayrı dalda yer alır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dalın ana konusu belirli yaşa ulaşıp yük ve binme için elverişli olan devedir; çiftleşme zamanı kalıba bağlıdır, semirme ise dışarıda tutulur.

lexicalization_scope.note: Yaş ve kullanıma elverişlilik erkek ve dişi adlarında korunur; dişinin çiftleşme zamanını bildiren söz öbeği ayrı bir kalıp olarak genelleştirilmez.

concept_map.definition: Üç yaşını tamamlayıp dördüncü yaşına girmiş ve yük taşımaya ya da binilmeye elverişli hale gelmiş erkek veya dişi devedir. Ayrı bir kalıp, dişi devenin çiftleşme için belirlenmiş zamanını anlatır.

facets.statement: Deve üç yaşını tamamlayıp dördüncü yaşına girerek yük ve binme için elverişli hale gelir.
Yaş ve elverişlilik adı hem erkek hem dişi deve için cinsiyete göre ayrı biçimde kullanılır.
Dişi devenin erkek deveyle çiftleştirildiği belirli zaman, kalıba bağlı ayrı bir zaman kullanımıdır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Toplu tanıklık, üç yaşını bitirip dördüncü yaşa giren devenin yük taşımaya elverişli sayılmasını temel alır; erkek ve dişi adlarını ve dişinin çiftleşme zamanını ayrıca belirtir.

concept_gloss.text: dördüncü yaşındaki yük taşımaya elverişli deve
concept_gloss.applicability: Üç yaşını tamamlamış erkek veya dişi devenin yaşını ve yük ya da binme için eriştiği elverişlilik aşamasını birlikte anlatır.

error_profile.preserves: Yaş sınırını, iki cinsiyeti ve yük ya da binme elverişliliğini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Dişi devenin dördüncü yaşa girdiğini ve yük taşımaya elverişli sayıldığını belirten sürü bağlamında kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Yaş eşiğini, dişi cinsiyetini ve kullanıma elverişliliği korur.
error_profile.loses: Erkek deve kullanımını ve çiftleşme zamanı kalıbını kapsamaz.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Dişi devenin erkek deveyle çiftleştirildiği belirli zamanı bildiren kalıpta uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Kalıba bağlı çiftleşme zamanı yönünü korur.
error_profile.loses: Devenin yaşını ve yük taşımaya elverişli hale gelmesini kapsamaz.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: üç yaşını tamamlamış, yük veya binme için elverişli dişi deve
üç yaşını tamamlamış, yük veya binme için elverişli erkek deve

neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal yük taşıyabilecek olsa bile saygı veya damızlık amacıyla yük vurulmayan deveyi belirtir.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dal kesin yaş eşiği ile yük ve binme elverişliliğini anlatır.

branches.source_phrase_ar: الحقة من أولاد الإبل ما استحق أن يحمل عليه (maqayis)؛ الحق من الإبل ابن ثلاث سنين وقد دخل في الرابعة والأنثى حقة (sihah;tahdhib)؛ الحق من الإبل ما استحق أن يحمل عليه والأنثى حقة (mufradat)؛ أتت الناقة على حقها أي الوقت الذي ضربت فيه (sihah;tahdhib;mufradat)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi yaranın iç boşluğa ulaşmasını, saplanışın eğrilmeden ilerlemesini ve delip geçmesini açıkça bir araya getirir. Dal kimliği bu fiziksel hareket ile sonucu doğru korur.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal, düz ilerleyip bedenin iç boşluğuna ulaşan saplanışla sınırlıdır; genel vurma, yüzeysel yaralama ve soyut çekişme dışarıdadır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Dalın çekirdeği saplanış söz öbeğinde belirgindir; avı öldürücü biçimde vurma kullanımı ayrı bir sözlük birimi olarak verilir ve genel saplanışa dönüştürülmez.

concept_map.definition: Eğrilmeden düz ilerleyen ve bedenin iç boşluğuna kadar ulaşarak delen bir saplanıştır.

facets.statement: Saplanan şey yüzeyde kalmayıp bedenin iç boşluğuna ulaşır.
Saplanışın yolundan sapmadan düz ilerlemesi, delip ulaşma sonucuna eşlik eden ayırıcı özelliktir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Toplu tanıklık, saplanışın iç boşluğa ulaşmasını ortak sonuç olarak verir ve buna yolundan sapmadan düz ilerleme özelliğini ekler.

concept_gloss.applicability: Bir sivri aracın eğrilmeden ilerleyip bedeni delerek iç boşluğa kadar ulaştığı yaralanmayı anlatır.

error_profile.preserves: Düz ilerleme, delme ve iç boşluğa ulaşma öğelerinin tümünü korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir mızrak veya benzeri sivri aracın bedeni delip iç boşluğa ulaştığı bağlamda doğal karşılıktır.

error_profile.preserves: Delip bedenin içine ulaşma sonucunu korur.
error_profile.loses: Saplanışın yolundan sapmadan düz ilerlediğini açıkça belirtmez.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: düz ilerleyip bedenin iç boşluğuna ulaşan saplanış
avın bir bölümünü öldürücü veya delici biçimde vurdu

neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal yarayı iç boşluğa ulaşıp onunla birleşmesi bakımından adlandırır, düzlüğü şart koşmaz.
neighbor_distinctions.gloss: düz delici saplanış ile iç boşluk yarası

neighbor_distinctions.gloss: içe ulaşan düz saplanış ile önden düz saplanış
